chapter: WWL and the Roosevelt Fountain Lounge
title: End of WWL and landing the Albert Coise job
summary: The station let them go; Frank got on with Albert Coise's band at the Roosevelt for 36 years.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: How many years did you stay on that one?
Until... We got put up before the union for playing underscale at WSMB.

And it was less than that. We stayed there two years until the station let us go. And when the station let us go, I was lucky enough to fall downstairs with Albert Coise and stayed there 36 years. That's what kept me in the business.

Yeah. I stayed down there. I played a job with him with Ray McNamara. And he told me, but Paul, Louis was playing bass then, you know. Yeah. And he told me, he says, say kid, he says, would you be interested in playing with me over there? And I said, yeah, I guess so. So he says, you'll hear from me. I said, well, how much did you get? Huh? $21? $21 a week? Yeah, $21 a week. $11. You had another day off, didn't you? Yeah. No, no, no, no. Day off.
